meta.title: Burning Heart
meta.description: Abandoning your past is not necessarily your way to clarity. In fact, it might make you even more lost.

units.rawText: Target located in gun control room.
units.displayText: Target located in gun control room.

spans.text: Target located in gun control room.

units.rawText: Now that the girl in black knows her enemy's location, she races off towards them.
units.displayText: Now that the girl in black knows her enemy's location, she races off towards them.

spans.text: Now that the girl in black knows her enemy's location, she races off towards them.

units.rawText: With the stake in her chest pulled out, a mix of liquid Entropy and her operands drips to the ground. Her sealed power has been released, though at the price of her life rapidly ebbing away.
units.displayText: With the stake in her chest pulled out, a mix of liquid Entropy and her operands drips to the ground. Her sealed power has been released, though at the price of her life rapidly ebbing away.

spans.text: With the stake in her chest pulled out, a mix of liquid Entropy and her operands drips to the ground. Her sealed power has been released, though at the price of her life rapidly ebbing away.

units.rawText: My strength is fading... I don't have much time...
units.displayText: My strength is fading... I don't have much time...

spans.text: My strength is fading... I don't have much time...

units.rawText: I need to kill the intruders before I fall...
units.displayText: I need to kill the intruders before I fall...

spans.text: I need to kill the intruders before I fall...

units.rawText: Before she realizes it, the control room is already in front of her. Just as Sol puts her hand on the handle, she is greeted by a dazzling light. She comes to her senses and backs off quickly.
units.displayText: Before she realizes it, the control room is already in front of her. Just as Sol puts her hand on the handle, she is greeted by a dazzling light. She comes to her senses and backs off quickly.

spans.text: Before she realizes it, the control room is already in front of her. Just as Sol puts her hand on the handle, she is greeted by a dazzling light. She comes to her senses and backs off quickly.

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: The place where she was standing just a moment ago is pulverized by operand shellfire.
units.displayText: The place where she was standing just a moment ago is pulverized by operand shellfire.

spans.text: The place where she was standing just a moment ago is pulverized by operand shellfire.

units.rawText: Just a beast in its cage.
units.displayText: Just a beast in its cage.

spans.text: Just a beast in its cage.

units.rawText: The girl in black does not hesitate and cuts open the door to the control room.
units.displayText: The girl in black does not hesitate and cuts open the door to the control room.

spans.text: The girl in black does not hesitate and cuts open the door to the control room.

units.rawText: The interior is dimly lit. I meet Sol's eyes for the first time, our faces hidden by shadow.
units.displayText: The interior is dimly lit. I meet Sol's eyes for the first time, our faces hidden by shadow.

spans.text: The interior is dimly lit. I meet Sol's eyes for the first time, our faces hidden by shadow.

units.rawText: You were waiting for me?
units.displayText: You were waiting for me?

spans.text: You were waiting for me?

units.rawText: Indeed.
units.displayText: Indeed.

spans.text: Indeed.

units.rawText: I glance over to the nearby control terminal, then quickly pull my gaze away.
units.displayText: I glance over to the nearby control terminal, then quickly pull my gaze away.

spans.text: I glance over to the nearby control terminal, then quickly pull my gaze away.

units.rawText: Not going to say anything like your friend did?
units.displayText: Not going to say anything like your friend did?

spans.text: Not going to say anything like your friend did?

units.rawText: I have access to the Watchtower cameras in this control room. I saw everything that happened between the two of you.
units.displayText: I have access to the Watchtower cameras in this control room. I saw everything that happened between the two of you.

spans.text: I have access to the Watchtower cameras in this control room. I saw everything that happened between the two of you.

units.rawText: I'm not Persicaria. Seeing people die in combat is second nature to me.
units.displayText: I'm not Persicaria. Seeing people die in combat is second nature to me.

spans.text: I'm not Persicaria. Seeing people die in combat is second nature to me.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter if they're your friends or FNGs who can't even hold a gun. Only one thing matters on the battlefield...
units.displayText: It doesn't matter if they're your friends or FNGs who can't even hold a gun. Only one thing matters on the battlefield...

spans.text: It doesn't matter if they're your friends or FNGs who can't even hold a gun. Only one thing matters on the battlefield...

units.rawText: ...Which is to make sure the people who are still alive stay that way.
units.displayText: ...Which is to make sure the people who are still alive stay that way.

spans.text: ...Which is to make sure the people who are still alive stay that way.

units.rawText: There are countless agents on the frontlines, and every single one of them runs the risk of being infected by the virus. So I can't stop here.
units.displayText: There are countless agents on the frontlines, and every single one of them runs the risk of being infected by the virus. So I can't stop here.

spans.text: There are countless agents on the frontlines, and every single one of them runs the risk of being infected by the virus. So I can't stop here.

units.rawText: Looks like you're different from that friend of yours who was going on and on about bonds and friendship. Thank you for being so ruthless, by the way. Now I needn't hesitate as I kill you.
units.displayText: Looks like you're different from that friend of yours who was going on and on about bonds and friendship. Thank you for being so ruthless, by the way. Now I needn't hesitate as I kill you.

spans.text: Looks like you're different from that friend of yours who was going on and on about bonds and friendship. Thank you for being so ruthless, by the way. Now I needn't hesitate as I kill you.

units.rawText: As long as you stand against me, you're my enemy. Doesn't matter if you're Sol or not.
units.displayText: As long as you stand against me, you're my enemy. Doesn't matter if you're Sol or not.

spans.text: As long as you stand against me, you're my enemy. Doesn't matter if you're Sol or not.

units.rawText: I'll fight to the last drop of blood. Even if my arms are broken or my legs are chopped off, even if it means having to pick up a rock and bash your head in.
units.displayText: I'll fight to the last drop of blood. Even if my arms are broken or my legs are chopped off, even if it means having to pick up a rock and bash your head in.

spans.text: I'll fight to the last drop of blood. Even if my arms are broken or my legs are chopped off, even if it means having to pick up a rock and bash your head in.

units.rawText: Oh, I like your spirit. Looks like we can have a good fight.
units.displayText: Oh, I like your spirit. Looks like we can have a good fight.

spans.text: Oh, I like your spirit. Looks like we can have a good fight.

units.rawText: There is a hint of bloodlust in her eyes.
units.displayText: There is a hint of bloodlust in her eyes.

spans.text: There is a hint of bloodlust in her eyes.

units.rawText: And that's it for the banter.
units.displayText: And that's it for the banter.

spans.text: And that's it for the banter.

units.rawText: Her blade screams as it scrapes across the ground. Her killing intent rolls out from her like a fog bank.
units.displayText: Her blade screams as it scrapes across the ground. Her killing intent rolls out from her like a fog bank.

spans.text: Her blade screams as it scrapes across the ground. Her killing intent rolls out from her like a fog bank.

units.rawText: You'll regret hiding in this dark little room and sniping me from afar. This place will be your tomb!
units.displayText: You'll regret hiding in this dark little room and sniping me from afar. This place will be your tomb!

spans.text: You'll regret hiding in this dark little room and sniping me from afar. This place will be your tomb!

units.rawText: You're the one who'll regret this!
units.displayText: You're the one who'll regret this!

spans.text: You're the one who'll regret this!

units.rawText: Foom!
units.displayText: Foom!

spans.text: Foom!

units.rawText: Her flame-wreathed glaive falls like a thunderbolt, slicing off several strands of my hair as it grazes past me. I hastily duck and just barely avoid the hit.
units.displayText: Her flame-wreathed glaive falls like a thunderbolt, slicing off several strands of my hair as it grazes past me. I hastily duck and just barely avoid the hit.

spans.text: Her flame-wreathed glaive falls like a thunderbolt, slicing off several strands of my hair as it grazes past me. I hastily duck and just barely avoid the hit.

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: (Even if I do manage to avoid the next few hits, the control room will collapse too.)
units.displayText: Even if I do manage to avoid the next few hits, the control room will collapse too.

spans.text: Even if I do manage to avoid the next few hits, the control room will collapse too.

units.rawText: I look past Sol who stands there in a wreath of fire, and at the green light blinking in the distance.
units.displayText: I look past Sol who stands there in a wreath of fire, and at the green light blinking in the distance.

spans.text: I look past Sol who stands there in a wreath of fire, and at the green light blinking in the distance.

units.rawText: Soon... it should be soon.
units.displayText: Soon... it should be soon.

spans.text: Soon... it should be soon.

units.rawText: I back off, keeping an eye on Sol's movements as I do.
units.displayText: I back off, keeping an eye on Sol's movements as I do.

spans.text: I back off, keeping an eye on Sol's movements as I do.

units.rawText: Are you counting on your friend to save you? Or do you have some other trick up your sleeves to change your fate?
units.displayText: Are you counting on your friend to save you? Or do you have some other trick up your sleeves to change your fate?

spans.text: Are you counting on your friend to save you? Or do you have some other trick up your sleeves to change your fate?

units.rawText: Whatever it is, I won't give you intruders a chance to flee!
units.displayText: Whatever it is, I won't give you intruders a chance to flee!

spans.text: Whatever it is, I won't give you intruders a chance to flee!

units.rawText: As she says that, she sweeps her glaive and sends a torrent of blade slashes out like an arrow storm, aiming at the wall behind me.
units.displayText: As she says that, she sweeps her glaive and sends a torrent of blade slashes out like an arrow storm, aiming at the wall behind me.

spans.text: As she says that, she sweeps her glaive and sends a torrent of blade slashes out like an arrow storm, aiming at the wall behind me.

units.rawText: Rumble—
units.displayText: Rumble—

spans.text: Rumble—

units.rawText: The wall collapses, utterly blocking off my path.
units.displayText: The wall collapses, utterly blocking off my path.

spans.text: The wall collapses, utterly blocking off my path.

units.rawText: ...There's nowhere to run, Professor.
units.displayText: ...There's nowhere to run, Professor.

spans.text: ...There's nowhere to run, Professor.

units.rawText: Hoho, did you really think I would run?
units.displayText: Hoho, did you really think I would run?

spans.text: Hoho, did you really think I would run?

units.rawText: Just a little more time...
units.displayText: Just a little more time...

spans.text: Just a little more time...

units.rawText: Still posturing, I see.
units.displayText: Still posturing, I see.

spans.text: Still posturing, I see.

units.rawText: Actually, you ought to call it "dreaming big".
units.displayText: Actually, you ought to call it "dreaming big".

spans.text: Actually, you ought to call it "dreaming big".

units.rawText: Come on, faster...
units.displayText: Come on, faster...

spans.text: Come on, faster...

units.rawText: As long as it finds you, all problems will be solved.
units.displayText: As long as it finds you, all problems will be solved.

spans.text: As long as it finds you, all problems will be solved.

units.rawText: It?
units.displayText: It?

spans.text: It?

units.rawText: I was referring to the sentry gun's enemy auto-tracking subroutine.
units.displayText: I was referring to the sentry gun's enemy auto-tracking subroutine.

spans.text: I was referring to the sentry gun's enemy auto-tracking subroutine.

units.rawText: Operand charge at 100%. Sentry gun fully charged. Target locked. Coordinates...
units.displayText: Operand charge at 100%. Sentry gun fully charged. Target locked. Coordinates...

spans.text: Operand charge at 100%. Sentry gun fully charged. Target locked. Coordinates...

units.rawText: A system alert suddenly chimes in, and Sol laughs thinly as she realizes that she's fallen for yet another ruse.
units.displayText: A system alert suddenly chimes in, and Sol laughs thinly as she realizes that she's fallen for yet another ruse.

spans.text: A system alert suddenly chimes in, and Sol laughs thinly as she realizes that she's fallen for yet another ruse.

units.rawText: I was waiting for it to charge up. What are you waiting for?
units.displayText: I was waiting for it to charge up. What are you waiting for?

spans.text: I was waiting for it to charge up. What are
you
waiting for?

units.rawText: I don't believe you'll actually shoot. You'd have to be suicidal to set off a high-explosive operand blast in a cramped room.
units.displayText: I don't believe you'll actually shoot. You'd have to be suicidal to set off a high-explosive operand blast in a cramped room.

spans.text: I don't believe you'll actually shoot. You'd have to be suicidal to set off a high-explosive operand blast in a cramped room.

units.rawText: <size=40>Then let's find out, shall we?!</size>
units.displayText: Then let's find out, shall we?!

spans.text: Then let's find out, shall we?!

units.rawText: I clench my fist, ready to give the command at any time.
units.displayText: I clench my fist, ready to give the command at any time.

spans.text: I clench my fist, ready to give the command at any time.

units.rawText: I told you, didn't I? To the last drop of blood!
units.displayText: I told you, didn't I? To the last drop of blood!

spans.text: I told you, didn't I?
To the last drop of blood!

units.rawText: <size=40>You're insane! Yeeart—</size>
units.displayText: You're insane! Yeeart—

spans.text: You're insane! Yeeart—

units.rawText: Sol's eyes go bloodshot as she swings her glaive. Its massive blade scythes down on me.
units.displayText: Sol's eyes go bloodshot as she swings her glaive. Its massive blade scythes down on me.

spans.text: Sol's eyes go bloodshot as she swings her glaive. Its massive blade scythes down on me.

units.rawText: Sentry gun! Fire—
units.displayText: Sentry gun! Fire—

spans.text: Sentry gun! Fire—

units.rawText: In response to the command, an energy beam fires at the girl in black.
units.displayText: In response to the command, an energy beam fires at the girl in black.

spans.text: In response to the command, an energy beam fires at the girl in black.

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: The operand pulse slams Sol into the wall behind her. Its energy melts through layer after layer of the walls, leaving a straight passage with melted edges.
units.displayText: The operand pulse slams Sol into the wall behind her. Its energy melts through layer after layer of the walls, leaving a straight passage with melted edges.

spans.text: The operand pulse slams Sol into the wall behind her. Its energy melts through layer after layer of the walls, leaving a straight passage with melted edges.

units.rawText: As the deafening echoes fill the air, my body suddenly goes weightless. I feel as if I am but a mere pebble launched into the air by a slingshot, eventually meeting the ground hard with a loud thwack.
units.displayText: As the deafening echoes fill the air, my body suddenly goes weightless. I feel as if I am but a mere pebble launched into the air by a slingshot, eventually meeting the ground hard with a loud thwack.

spans.text: As the deafening echoes fill the air, my body suddenly goes weightless. I feel as if I am but a mere pebble launched into the air by a slingshot, eventually meeting the ground hard with a loud thwack.

units.rawText: How do you... like that...
units.displayText: How do you... like that...

spans.text: How do you... like that...

units.rawText: The control room is crumbling to pieces before my eyes, but before my mind sinks into darkness, I hear a voice.
units.displayText: The control room is crumbling to pieces before my eyes, but before my mind sinks into darkness, I hear a voice.

spans.text: The control room is crumbling to pieces before my eyes, but before my mind sinks into darkness, I hear a voice.

units.rawText: <size=40>PROFESSOR!!!</size>
units.displayText: PROFESSOR!!!

spans.text: PROFESSOR!!!

units.rawText: Uuuurgh...
units.displayText: Uuuurgh...

spans.text: Uuuurgh...

units.rawText: What a reassuring voice.
units.displayText: What a reassuring voice.

spans.text: What a reassuring voice.

units.rawText: Persicaria... it's all up to you now.
units.displayText: Persicaria... it's all up to you now.

spans.text: Persicaria... it's all up to you now.
